name: GitHub Copilot
description: Maintainers get access to Copilot Enterprise.

name: Kapa.ai
description: Handles community questions, reducing the volume of inbound support questions maintainers manage directly.

name: Dosu
description: AI teammate that lives in your GitHub repository, helping you respond to issues, triage bugs, and build better documentation. Early access program; mention CNCF when applying.

name: Sourcegraph
description: Complimentary AI and code search workspace licenses for eligible open source developers who actively maintain a CNCF project.

name: Gitpod
description: On-demand cloud development environments, pre-configured with the tools, libraries, and dependencies required to be ready to code.

name: CI/CD support
description: CNCF covers CI needs for hosted projects, which select their own platforms, including GitHub Actions and Prow. Projects in the CNCF GitHub Enterprise account gain access to larger runners and runners hosted across environments using the GitHub Actions Runner Controller.

name: Prow GitHub Actions
description: Prow-style chat-ops, OWNERS-based reviewers, automatic merging, and label sync as a GitHub Actions workflow. Maintained by CNCF staff.

name: AWS credits
description: Cloud credits for hosting on Amazon Web Services.

name: Google Cloud credits
description: Cloud credits for hosting on Google Cloud.

name: Oracle Cloud (OCI) credits
description: Cloud credits for hosting on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

name: Akamai/Linode credits
description: Cloud credits for hosting on Akamai/Linode.

name: Docker Sponsored Open Source
description: Direct access to Docker's Sponsored Open Source (DSOS) program, including upgraded Docker Hub registry, Docker Hardened Images, security, and support services.

name: Netlify
description: Website hosting, DNS management, and workflow automation for documentation and websites.

name: Fastly
description: Fastly has committed to support CNCF and Linux Foundation projects. Apply for access directly with Fastly.

name: Scarf
description: Analytics for container and artifact distribution, package installation, and web traffic to documentation.

name: Domain registration
description: CNCF neutrally registers and manages domains on behalf of projects. gTLDs such as .org, .net, .com, and .dev are preferred; new .io and premium domains are not registered.

name: CNCF FOSSA
description: Dedicated CNCF FOSSA instance that scans projects for third-party licenses not on the approved allowlist.

name: CNCF Snyk
description: Dedicated CNCF Snyk tenancy that scans projects for third-party licenses not on the approved allowlist. Projects can use CNCF FOSSA, CNCF Snyk, or both.

name: LFX Security
description: Source code security scanning and license compliance (white-labeled Snyk).

name: Kusari Inspector
description: Visibility into versions, licenses, and security risks for direct and transitive dependencies.

name: Minder
description: OpenSSF sandbox project that automates and maintains consistent repository security configurations, safeguarding supply chain assets.

name: Sonatype Lift
description: Cloud native, collaborative code analysis platform built for developers.

name: HackerOne
description: Bug bounty programs.

name: Security audits
description: Security audits from independent third parties (for example, the Kubernetes security audit).

name: Distributed systems safety research
description: Distributed systems safety research through independent third parties, such as Jepsen.

name: Fuzzing with OSS-Fuzz
description: Guidance on integrating fuzz testing, often combined with OSS-Fuzz, a free service that runs fuzzers continuously.

name: 1Password
description: Free Teams accounts for open source projects to manage shared secrets. Apply directly through the 1Password for Open Source program.

name: Keybase
description: Manage access to shared secrets.

name: CNCF Slack
description: Communication for all projects in the Cloud Native Computing Foundation Slack, including migration of existing workspaces.

name: Zoom
description: Zoom Pro accounts for video meetings, recordings, and scheduling.

name: Discourse
description: Community discussion forums (for example, discuss.kubernetes.io).

name: GitVote
description: GitHub application that allows voting in issues and pull requests.

name: CLOWarden
description: GitOps-based access control service that controls and audits access to GitHub repositories for individuals and teams.

name: CLOTributor
description: Search engine for people looking for opportunities to become cloud native contributors.

name: Credly badges
description: Custom digital badges to recognize contributors (Maintainer, Contributor, Chop Wood Carry Water, Documentarian). Up to four badges per year for each graduated project.

name: Holopin
description: Lightweight digital badges that maintainers can use to recognize contributors. Not CNCF managed; apply directly to Holopin's open source program.

name: Program management and governance
description: CNCF staff assist with project governance creation and advice, and collaboration with LF Fellows and sister projects.

name: Project office hours
description: Monthly public office hours with CNCF staff, or private meetings on request.

name: DevStats
description: Project activity tracking and contribution reporting.

name: LFX Insights
description: Project activity tracking and contribution reporting.

name: CLOMonitor
description: Scans repositories daily for adherence to best practices, helping assess the health of open source projects.

name: Trademarks and project assets
description: Neutral home for project assets and trademarks, trademark registration across geographies, and defense against third-party challenges and misuse.

name: CLA and DCO verification
description: Contributor License Agreement (CLA) signature and validation and Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) sign-off verification systems that integrate with GitHub.

name: Licensing review and litigation support
description: Assistance with open source licensing review and strategy, and support with threatened litigation against CNCF projects.

name: License exception requests
description: CNCF manages the license exception request process and coordinates Legal Committee and Governing Board reviews.

name: License Exceptions Dashboard
description: List of software components that have been granted license exceptions.

name: Documentation analysis
description: Analysis to help projects understand where to improve their documentation. CNCF recommends requesting a docs assessment before other documentation services.

name: Technical writers and contractors
description: Technical writers and contractors for specific projects.

name: Tech docs office hours
description: Monthly Q&A sessions with the CNCF technical writers.

name: Design and logos
description: Graphic design from the CNCF in-house design team, including new logos, website refreshes, and enhancements to an existing aesthetic.

name: CNCF artwork repository
description: Project logos and color schemes.

name: CNCF Online Programs
description: Webinars, videos, and livestreams to communicate release details or project updates.

name: CNCF and Kubernetes blogs
description: Submit technical content, how-tos, deployment stories, and use cases to the CNCF blog and the Kubernetes.io blog.

name: Editorial support
description: CNCF manages the blog editorial calendar and provides writing, editing, and funding for freelancers to develop content.

name: Case studies
description: End user case studies featuring use cases and the impact of CNCF projects on end users' businesses.

name: CNCF newsletter
description: Monthly newsletter with project updates as a regular feature.

name: Media velocity reports
description: Monthly press mentions and share-of-voice data for all projects, including social media mentions and key messaging.

name: Fashion a Phippy
description: Graduated projects can donate a character to the Phippy and Friends program.

name: Media, analyst, and social outreach
description: Media and analyst coverage, briefings, publication and podcast placement, thought leadership reports, and social media channel management.

name: Surveys
description: Help creating surveys to learn about adoption or other interests, including the annual Cloud Native Community Surveys.

name: Graduation announcement
description: Press release, KubeCon + CloudNativeCon presentation slot, embargoed media pitch with CNCF PR-staffed interviews, and announcement-day social post.

name: Incubation announcement
description: cncf.io blog post written with the project team, embargoed media pitch, and announcement-day social post.

name: Sandbox announcement
description: Announcement to the TOC mailing list on the day of acceptance, and introductions if media contact CNCF.

name: Release support
description: Project webinars (up to two per year), cncf.io release blog post, media pitch, and announcement-day social post. Graduated projects: major and minor releases. Incubating projects: major releases.

name: CNCF-hosted co-located events
description: Event planning and logistics, integrated marketing, sponsorship, and media introductions for CNCF-hosted co-located events at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon and Open Source Summit. Also open to TAGs.

name: Virtual events
description: Virtual-only events, open to all projects, TAGs, and SIGs.

name: Project Pavilion kiosk
description: In-person kiosk in the Project Pavilion at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon.

name: In-person project meeting
description: Meeting space for projects at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon.

name: Maintainer track session
description: Maintainer session at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon.

name: Event PR support
description: PR support at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon. Also open to TAGs and SIGs.

name: CNCF booth at industry events
description: CNCF sponsors industry and Linux Foundation events, often with a booth that maintainers can join and use as a home base.

name: Community groups and Ambassadors
description: Connect with the worldwide network of Cloud Native Community Groups and CNCF Ambassadors to raise awareness of your project.

name: Travel funding
description: Travel funding for non-corporate-backed developers. See each event's scholarship page for eligibility.

name: Introduction to Kubernetes (edX)
description: Free introductory Kubernetes course.

name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
description: Certification exam.

name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
description: Certification exam.

name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
description: Certification exam.

name: Monitoring Systems and Services with Prometheus
description: Linux Foundation training course (LFS241).

name: Project training course development
description: Work with the Linux Foundation training team to develop self-paced online courses for a project.
